import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/training_6.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Ensure columns are exactly ['air_store_id', 'dow'] with correct types
    df = df[['air_store_id', 'dow']].copy()
    df['air_store_id'] = df['air_store_id'].astype(str)
    df['dow'] = df['dow'].astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# Operation: UNION all source tables as per operation_history
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure target schema: ['air_store_id': string, 'dow': integer]
target_df = target_df.astype({'air_store_id': str, 'dow': int})

# Write the result to the specified path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_89/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
